en.tool.description: Search Japanese public-transit routes and fares with Yahoo! Japan Transit. Returns multiple candidate routes, travel time, transfers, fare, and itinerary.
en.param.origin.description: Departure station, bus stop, address, or facility.
en.param.destination.description: Arrival station, bus stop, address, or facility.
en.param.departure.description: Optional local departure date/time in ISO 8601 format. Defaults to the current local time.
en.param.max_routes.description: Maximum number of candidate routes to return (1-6, default: 3).
en.param.sort_by.description: Route order: recommended/fastest, cheapest, or fewest_transfers.
en.param.ticket.description: Fare preference: ic (default) or normal ticket.
en.param.avoid.description: Transport types to avoid: shinkansen, limited_express, airline, highway_bus, local_bus, or ship.

tr.param.max_routes.description: Geri dönülecek maksimum aday rota sayısı (1-6, varsayılan: 3).
tr.param.sort_by.description: Rota sırası: önerilen/en hızlı, en ucuz veya en az transfer.
tr.param.ticket.description: Ücret tercihi: ic (varsayılan) veya normal bilet.

uk.tool.description: Шукайте японські маршрути громадського транспорту та тарифи за допомогою Yahoo! Японський транзит. Повертає кілька варіантів маршрутів, час у дорозі, пересадки, вартість проїзду та маршрут.
